unit: DGHS clinical facility row nested inside sampled registry upazila rows

source_inputs.role: upazila registry-map disagreement and exposure proxy
public DGHS facility rows, names, types, and coordinates

selection_rules.division_diversity_rule: Select deterministic top rows with a per-division cap first, then backfill if a group cannot reach quota.
selection_rules.facility_rule: Within each sampled upazila, select active clinical DGHS rows, preferring coordinate-ready and principal-tier rows while retaining community-level rows when available.

public_validation_sources.role: Registry row, facility name, type, public/private flag, clinical-tier flag, and coordinate field.
Candidate public-map health features using amenity=hospital/clinic/doctors near DGHS coordinates or by name/upazila search.

public_validation_sources.source: Google Open Buildings V3 p85 denominator
public_validation_sources.role: Settlement-exposure context only; not a facility validation source.

validation_codes.meaning: A public OSM feature and the DGHS row appear to describe the same facility.
Names differ but public evidence suggests duplicate naming or aliasing.
The DGHS row and OSM feature use materially different facility classifications.
DGHS coordinates are missing, implausible, or too uncertain for local OSM matching.
DGHS row is public and coordinate-ready, but no plausible OSM health feature is found nearby.
OSM feature appears plausible but no corresponding DGHS row is identified in the sampled registry rows.
Public evidence is insufficient to assign one of the above codes.

non_claim: This artifact is a validation-sample design. It does not report match rates, does not decide whether DGHS or OSM is ground truth, and does not validate facility existence, quality, access, service demand, or travel time.
